verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so default DDoS protection and a WAF are a fair question to ask. However, no evidence item mentions DDoS mitigation or a web application firewall. Related items (free TLS certificates, a global CDN for static assets, private networking, environment isolation, and the generic word "securing" in llms.txt) are adjacent features and do not show per-request DDoS or WAF protection.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
